dialogues.speaker: Fontemer Aberrant: Blubberbeast
dialogues.text: "But consider this: the 'lazy and degenerate lower creature' (as the Remurians once called it) has wandered through the seas far longer than the entirety of Remuria's own civilization endured."

dialogues.speaker: Fontemer Aberrant: Blubberbeast
dialogues.text: "By that measure, the Blubberbeast may be closer to eternity than any empire that has ever risen... and certainly closer to the perfect sphere."
